messages:
Jordan Park: FYI Veridian exec pinged — they want a firm delivery plan for Private deployment + a batching/quantization config by end of Q3. They quoted Aug 15 for a canary.
Priya Singh: Do we have a clear MLP defined for the canary? Is it just private control plane + basic metrics, or do they expect autoscale and SSO out of the gate?
Evelyn Brooks: Veridian signed the PO but pushed for a pilot before the next invoice. They want SSO + audit logs, and a demo of latency numbers on their 2k qps baseline. Can confirm the Aug 15 ask is from their infra lead.
Mateo Ruiz: 2k qps on private depends on model choice. If they use a 13B float model we need GPU headroom or quantized weights. Quantization + compiler tuning is ~3–4 weeks of eng effort to validate for their perf targets.
Alice Chen: For Private canary we can do a single-region cluster with pinned instance types. Autoscale can be disabled during canary to keep things predictable. KMS + audit logs are straightforward (1 week) assuming we reuse our existing Private infra templates.
Priya Singh: OK. Proposal: scope the canary to: 1) Private control plane deployable to their VPC, 2) SSO + audit logs, 3) baseline perf run with our recommended quantized model variant, 4) basic Redwood Console dashboard and alerting. Defer advanced autoscale policies and custom quantization profiles to post-canary. Thoughts?
Evelyn Brooks: That aligns with what Veridian will accept as "pilot". They'll sign off on a canary that proves latency and reliability, then open SOW for scale.
Mateo Ruiz: Agree. Need to call out risk: if we can't meet 2k qps with quantized 13B we either ask them to use a 7B variant or increase GPU commit. I'll run perf sims and post numbers by EOD Mon.
Jordan Park: Can we map dates? If we target Aug 15 for canary, what are the backward milestones?
Alice Chen: Rough timeline: infra templates + KMS/SSO integration (2w), model quantization + tuning (3w parallel), console dashboard + alerts (1w). End-to-end smoke + perf testing (3–4 days). So starting July 20 get us close for Aug 15.
Priya Singh: Action items / owners: Mateo -> perf sims + recommended model variant by Mon (1785096000). Alice -> infra templates & KMS workkick by July 21. Evelyn -> lock down Veridian engineering lead availability for perf window (target week of Aug 10). Jordan -> update customer-facing delivery note and escalate budget if GPU commit needed. I'll own the canary acceptance criteria doc.
Jordan Park: @release-bot can we schedule a reminder for the Aug 15 canary cutoff?
release-bot: Reminder set for 2026-08-15 09:00 UTC — "Veridian canary cutoff".
Evelyn Brooks: Quick note for negotiations: we should offer a phased billing credit if canary delays due to our tuning work. Helps soften timeline risk.
Priya Singh: Good idea. Jordan, work with finance on a small credit proposal.
Jordan Park: Will do.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll post the perf sim gist here when done: https://redwood.internal/gists/veridian-perf-sim
Priya Singh: Thanks all. I'll draft the acceptance criteria doc and share a short thread in the customer workspace. Keep replies short — want to present a tight plan to Veridian tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: ack
Evelyn Brooks: ack :shipit:
Mateo Ruiz: ack
Jordan Park: Thanks — closing for now.
